program.name: Upper Body Roulette
program.subject: Variety
program.blurb: Upper body every day, never the same twice: chest, back, shoulders, arms, grip and more in new formats.
program.about: The upper body every day, never the same session twice. Each day deals chest, back, shoulders, arms, push, pull, upper back, forearms, bodyweight push-ups or floor pulls, a kettlebell press or a gentle neck-and-traps day, each in a different format. The same kind never lands two days running, and neck days stay calm. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III slows every rep down.
program.split: Every day different · upper body only
